configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Warnings visible but not fatal, and the build directory scripts/setup.sh already uses, so a local tree and the installer's own build never disagree about where the binary lands.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Release quality: the same warnings the dev build prints, promoted to errors. This is the preset the release CI job has always effectively used.

configurePresets.name: sanitizers
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer against the step-policy unit tests.
